convention.availability_rule: Maximum receive clock of complete containing F_LAST source prefix.
convention.close_rule: Exclusive end timestamp declared in source DBN metadata; unobserved final tail remains censored.
convention.mark_rule: First source-order eligible trade record at each strictly advancing distinct event timestamp; duplicate same-event trades remain fully retained raw evidence, but are not duplicate time knots.
convention.opening_rule: First source-order eligible trade at the next strictly greater event timestamp.
convention.prior_reference_rule: First source-order eligible trade in this supplied source; mapped into prior_close API field only, never an official exchange prior close.
convention.source_flags: Raw quality flags are retained in observation evidence; no clean-book or exchange settlement certification inferred.
convention.tick_basis: Frozen pre-Sunday knowledge tick_raw=1000000 with source fixed-point scale=1000000000; all actual trade prices conform.
convention.usd_basis: Explicit development numeraire; actual NG contract multiplier unidentified in supplied MBO metadata.

query_policy.availability: No future fill. A query without an observed causal target by learning cutoff remains missing. No path/gap training during timing stage.
query_policy.rule: For j=0..7, hash canonical {seed,cycle_index,ordinal:j}; integer digest modulo (close_ns-event_cutoff_ns) plus event_cutoff_ns+1. Deduplicate and sort absolute integer UTC ns. Convert to offsets from open_ns for path queries.

scope_and_limitations: One supplied source day; no separate prior-day prerequisite. Own-source analytical interval, not official exchange-session P&L.
All 57027 source records decoded and preserved by exact source wire witness. Historical 18 sections reused with original authorship; not recomputed.
Only new interval, anchors, observation projection and causal policy authored here. No BOSS output received and no BOSS feedback/learning performed.
UTC nanoseconds are source representation resolution; timestamp noise floor is unidentified.
Actual NG contract USD multiplier absent from supplied metadata; explicit 1.0 development numeraire does not establish exchange dollars per contract.
Nominal final source tail is unobserved. Final STOP is censored unless independent closure evidence arrives.
C15 source_prefix_hash fields remain null until host binds exact completed journal prefixes. Never substitute raw-source file digest.
session_context: Existing agent session explicitly assigned Frankie principal role by root after failed fresh-agent dispatch; no claim of fresh context.

timing_policy.basis: One documented source tick, minimal nonzero unsmoothed directional-change threshold; not optimized to outcomes.
timing_policy.capacity_basis: Every source record could supply at most one strictly-timed mark; source population bound preserves full representability.
timing_policy.causal_detector: Process canonical projected trades in source order. Start direction=unknown at opening. A one-tick displacement establishes direction; track running extreme. A reversal of at least one tick emits the confirmation trade event timestamp (not a retrospectively backdated extreme); set new direction/extreme. Never smooth or optimize threshold using later prices.
timing_policy.coordinate_resolution_basis: Exact wire integer coordinate, not noise-floor accuracy claim.
timing_policy.feedback_limit: Only confirmation observations available at or before the next permitted learning cutoff; no label computation is performed in this source-contract artifact.
timing_policy.teacher_forcing: Begin previous_ns=max(0,event_cutoff_ns-open_ns),previous_delay_ns=0. For each observed future confirmation strictly later than previous_ns, emit its offset as next_ns and update previous_delay_ns. No STOP until close_ns is actually observed; missing/censored future stays omitted, not zero.
